title: Employment zones reform (New South Wales)
summary: From 26 April 2023 NSW replaced business and industrial zones with simpler employment zones that permit a wider range of uses.

instruments.title: Standard Instrument (Local Environmental Plans) Amendment (Land Use Zones) Order 2022

direction_rationale: Wider permitted uses lower the planning barrier to opening new businesses, including supermarkets, in more locations.
comparison: Other states; variation across local government areas

verified.notes: Date from NSW Planning's reform page.

review.notes: Drafted by AI-assisted desk research on 18 October 2026 (legislation gap scan, docs/legislation_gap_scan.md) from the sources cited. Not yet checked by a person: verify dates, industries and the direction hypothesis before use.

assessment.summary: Replaced business and industrial zones with simpler employment zones that permit a wider range of uses. More places where new businesses, including supermarkets, can open without rezoning.

marks.reason: Wider permitted uses lower the planning barrier to opening new businesses.
Fewer, simpler zones mean fewer rezoning and development applications.
